name: Tun Kofe
tagline: Coffee and desserts for the sleepless
niche: Late-night coffee shop open till 3 am

listing.description: A site for a late-night coffee shop, bar or café that comes alive after sunset. A neon sign, a ticket-machine menu and opening hours right on the first screen.

seo.title: Tun Kofe — late-night coffee shop in Tashkent till 3 am
seo.description: Coffee, raf, matcha and desserts from 6 pm to 3 am at 21 Shevchenko St. A quiet room for night work, sockets everywhere, coffee and cake delivery across Mirabad.
keywords: where to work at night Tashkent
seo.answer: Tun Kofe is a late-night coffee shop at 21 Taras Shevchenko St in Tashkent, open daily from 6 pm to 3 am. A cappuccino costs 28,000 UZS, a raf 34,000 UZS and a cheesecake 36,000 UZS. There is a quiet room with sockets and delivery across Mirabad until 2:30 am.

sections.title: Tun Kofe
sections.subtitle: We open when everyone else closes. Fresh espresso, warm desserts and quiet for anyone writing a thesis, editing a video or simply not sleepy.

sections.label: About
sections.title: A café for night owls
sections.text: We used to work nights ourselves and could never find a place to sit with a laptop after ten. So Tun Kofe opens at six in the evening: soft light, a socket at every table, fast Wi-Fi and music that does not get in the way of thinking.

items.title: Order
items.text: Tap “Order” and write what to bring.

items.title: Call
items.text: The barista calls back within five minutes to confirm the address.

items.title: Thermal box
items.text: Drinks travel in a thermal box so the foam holds.

items.title: At your door
items.text: About 30 minutes across Mirabad; last order at 2:30 am.

sections.label: The room
sections.title: Light that does not get in the way

items.quote: I finished my thesis in four nights at the corner table. Lavender raf now smells like graduation.
items.author: Malika

items.quote: After a night shift at the hospital it is the only place open with decent coffee.
items.author: Otabek

items.q: Are you really open till three?
items.a: Yes, every day from 6 pm to 3 am, no days off. Last order at the counter is 2:45.

items.q: Can I stay all night with a laptop?
items.a: Yes. Every table has a socket, Wi-Fi is 200 Mbit/s and there is no time limit.
Across Mirabad and the neighbouring parts of Yakkasaray. Minimum order 60,000 UZS.
Yes: decaf, cocoa, sea buckthorn tea and herbal blends.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Can’t sleep?
sections.text: 21 Shevchenko St, entrance from the courtyard. Every day 6 pm to 3 am. Order coffee home and we bring it in half an hour.
